$comment: Source: Rider.pdf (3 image pages). Transcribed word for word from the page images, set in sentence case instead of the PDF's capitals. Do not paraphrase: promoters sign against this text.

groups.heading: DJ equipment (must be provided by the promoter)

items.text: 1 × Pioneer DJM-V10 (preferred) or Pioneer DJM-A9 in perfect working condition. All FX must be fully functional. If neither mixer is available, please contact management in advance.
4 × Pioneer CDJ-3000 (all linked via Ethernet cable). All CDJs must be at the same height as the mixer (not raised or on stands). Only CDJ-3000 units are accepted (latest firmware installed).
2 × booth monitors & 2 × sub booth monitors (L-Acoustics or d&b preferred, no Void Acoustics). Monitors must be positioned close to the artist with independent volume control.
2 × electric fans (e.g., tilt floor fans).
Must be solid and stable.
Table height ~100 cm, covered with solid panel or black cloth.
1 double room (king-size bed) in a 5-star international chain hotel (Sheraton, Hilton, Radisson, Sofitel, Westin, etc.).
breakfast, free high-speed internet, late check-out (no earlier than 4 pm), 24-hour room service & reception.
Hotel should be centrally located, near the venue, or at the airport.
Any applicable internet charges (up to 30 EUR) must be covered by the promoter.
3-course hot meal (regional specialties preferred, no fast food). If no dinner is arranged, a 100 EUR/USD meal buyout must be provided.
still water, herbal tea pot.
Premium or luxury vehicle must be provided. The driver must speak fluent English to avoid miscommunication.
Driver must be punctual, sober, professional, and drive safely. The driver must be easy to identify, holding a sign with "OPPAACHA" upon arrival.
Round-trip travel for OPPAACHA must be covered by the inviting party.
For cities requiring a visa, the organizers must arrange the visa unless the DJ already holds a valid one for the destination.
Tickets must be purchased and sent at least two weeks before the event date.
Any additional baggage fees must be covered by the organizers.

tabs.label: Payment & other
tabs.title: Payment terms and other

items.text: 50% of the artist's fee must be paid within one week of booking the date, but no later than two weeks before the performance.
The remaining 50% must be paid upon the artist's arrival in the performance city.
Payments must be made via bank transfer or another agreed-upon method, with all transaction fees covered by the promoter.
up to 20 guests on the artist's list will have free entry.
must be private, clean, and secure. Climate-controlled with power outlets and comfortable seating for 5 people.
Security must ensure the safety of the artist and their equipment.
In case of theft or vandalism, the promoter is liable for full compensation.
no performance recordings allowed without prior approval. Any recorded material must be sent to management for authorization before use.

tabs.closing: For any questions or clarifications, please contact OPPAACHA's management in advance.
